notes.title: Patch 1.83
notes.content:
We've added an update to Land of Leng, replacing a lot of menu and UI sounds, including the battle screen! Some of these sound effects include:
new menu navigation sounds (more magic-y sounding)
more sound feedback during battle, like Nei getting hurt, when an enemy gains Guard, etc.
reduced Volume of opening music when you bootup the game
cloth sounds to the Equipment UI

We hope you continue to enjoy playing Land of Leng and all the spiciness it offers!
